scope: Managed Gazebo UDP/native-exit correction, short scenes and one full-room actual-controller success. Design and simulation only.

primary_evidence.interpretation: Heap corruption was detected during Fast DDS shared-memory teardown. This stack does not identify the original corrupting write. UDPv4 is a scoped workaround, not a proven upstream repair.

changes: Managed lab launch defaults Fast DDS builtin transports to UDPv4; explicit parent transport choice and legacy mode remain unchanged.
Optional motion audit records the requested DDS builtin transport.
Relay catches expected KeyboardInterrupt/ExternalShutdownException only; cleanup still runs and other failures propagate.

Existing regression launcher creates a private Gazebo transport partition and asks /server_control to stop after scorer exit. A positive native reply delegates shutdown to the existing required-Gazebo exit; missing/failed reply retains immediate Launch shutdown. No new worker, tool, node or timer.
